functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: System successfully generates a filtered list of shortlisted candidates from a given pool of uploaded resumes.
functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall automatically shortlist candidates for software engineering roles based on resume analysis.

functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Candidates are displayed as an ordered list accompanied by an overall relevance score relative to the job description.
functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall rank candidates in descending order based on their relevance to the provided job description.

functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Relevance algorithm factors in individual sub-scores for skills match, experience, company tier/reputation, project complexity, and impact metrics.
functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall evaluate candidate relevance based on extracted skills, experience duration, company background, project quality, and documented impact.

functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Test cases demonstrate that entry-level candidates (freshers) with exceptional project impact can achieve higher overall scores than candidates with 5 years of average experience.
functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall evaluate candidate experience using dynamic weighting that allows high skill proficiency and strong project impact to outweigh lower total years of experience.

functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: System successfully parses and extracts structured features from unstructured historical resume files and associated decision records.
functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall ingest and process unstructured historical resume data and past hiring decisions to support model evaluation and training.

non_functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Every candidate rank score includes top contributing feature factors (e.g., key matching skills, strong project experience) displayed in the UI.
non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall provide rationale explaining why a candidate was given a specific ranking score.

non_functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Model evaluation demonstrates demographic parity and an equalized odds ratio between 0.80 and 1.25 across gender groups and college tiers; gender and college names are excluded or masked during scoring.
non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall prevent bias based on candidate gender and college background during profile evaluation and ranking.

non_functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Average processing time per resume does not exceed 3 seconds for parsing, scoring, and generating explanations (requires explicit baseline confirmation with stakeholders).
non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall process and score resumes rapidly without causing significant latency for users.

non_functional_requirements.measurable_criteria: Top-10 candidate shortlists generated by the system achieve at least 80% agreement (Precision@10 >= 0.80) with manual shortlists created by human HR recruiters.
non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system's ranking accuracy shall be high enough to establish trust with HR stakeholders.
